title: SEC-TESTS: bt5.7 sieve compile error assertion is too weak
description: The unit test sieve_for_user_compile_error_returns_err only asserts result.is_err(). It does not verify the error is a compilation error vs. an I/O error. A DB failure would produce the same pass. Test should assert the Err variant is a SieveCompileError, not any Err.
